name: UpLearn LMS
summary: An enterprise LMS from Hong Kong, now at version 7.0, for company training: online, mobile and classroom learning in one system, with question-pool exams, an audit record of each attempt and CPD tracking, offered as shared SaaS, private cloud or on-premise.

value: multi-entity training with separate areas per business unit
Course builder mixing SCORM and AICC packages, HTML5, video, documents, tests and assignments
Enrolment by role, department or rule, with approval workflows
Online and mobile delivery, with completion tracked as learners progress
Classroom sessions with facility booking, attendance and reminders
Exam engine with question pools, random or fixed papers, time and attempt limits, and an audit record of each attempt
Dashboards and downloadable reports for managers and auditors
Training Centers that keep each business unit's courses and records separate
single sign-on with existing identity systems

deployment.note: Bebox Corp (standard shared SaaS), Bebox Enterprise (dedicated private cloud on AWS, Microsoft Azure or Alibaba Cloud, or the customer's own data centre) and on-premise. The private-cloud providers don't tell us where the shared Bebox Corp service is hosted.

value.notes: Pricing on request. No billing basis, starting price or minimum contract is published.

accessibility.finding: No accessibility standard or conformance report is named on the UpLearn or About pages.

security.finding: No security certifications are named on the UpLearn or About pages.

dataResidency.finding: On-premise keeps data inside the customer's own infrastructure, and the Bebox Enterprise private cloud runs on AWS, Microsoft Azure or Alibaba Cloud, or in the customer's data centre. The hosting provider, region and processing location of the shared Bebox Corp SaaS service are not stated, and no privacy or data-retention policy is linked from the pages we opened.

ai.finding: No AI features are described on the UpLearn page, and Cyberwisdom told us it is not claiming an AI-powered LMS.

procurementChecks: Confirm the contracting company and its registration.
Ask where the shared SaaS edition is hosted, and for the privacy policy and data processing terms.
Request any security certifications or penetration-test summary, and an accessibility conformance report.

researchTasks: Submitted at /submit on 11 Nov 2026 by Karilyn Cheung, Marketing Director (accepted). 13 Nov 2026 email: asked for the ordinary free profile, no scored review or test environment; product name UpLearn LMS 7.0; facts to come from the Hong Kong site only. Still to confirm internally (they offered to send answers): contracting entity, billing basis, starting price and minimum contract, shared SaaS hosting provider and region, data storage and processing locations, privacy and retention policy, SCORM editions and AICC transport, xAPI, cmi5, LTI, certificate expiry and renewal, Open Badges, security certifications, accessibility evidence, any AI features and data-training policy.

Custom Courseware (https://www.cyberwisdom.com.hk/bespoke-courseware/) is a separate service for bespoke content that runs in UpLearn or other LMSs via SCORM/AICC. If it's ever mentioned on the profile, present it as a separate service, not an UpLearn module.
Hands-on review depends on a test site; a vendor-led demo doesn't count as an evaluation. Not requested at this stage (13 Nov 2026).
